name: Time Traveller
description: Turned the clock forward. Nice try, the timers live on the server.
short_descr: Some owls are always in a hurry.

name: Cheese Moon
description: Seven taps and the moon turned into cheese.
short_descr: The moon looks tasty tonight.

name: Quiet Hour
description: Let the owl fall asleep on the branch.
short_descr: Sometimes the best move is no move.

name: Too Bright
description: Light theme at night? The owl needed shades.
short_descr: Owls hate bright screens at night.

name: Jackpot
description: Three items from one egg. The wheel loves you.
short_descr: Some eggs are fuller than others.

name: Night Owl
description: Three midnights in a row. GM, night shift.
short_descr: Real owls don't sleep at midnight.

name: Ninja
description: Won a fight in complete silence.
short_descr: The quietest owl wins.

name: Untouchable
description: Won a fight without taking a single hit.
short_descr: Every knife missed.

name: Sushi Master
description: Three sushi in one flight. The scale disagrees.
short_descr: Some flights are all-you-can-eat.

name: Sweet Dream
description: Dozed off to the flute and dreamed of a coin.
short_descr: Turn off the lamp and listen.

name: Long Shift
description: One full hour in a single session.
short_descr: Row, row, row your chair.

name: Full Moon
description: Seven taps on a real full moon. Eyes on fire.
short_descr: One night a month the moon answers back.

name: Peacemaker
description: A fight ended in a draw. Nobody shot first.
short_descr: Sometimes nobody wins, and that's the point.

name: Not a Clicker
description: We all miss Notcoin, but it's not a clicker.
short_descr: Tap tap tap... wait, wrong game.

name: Roll the Credits
description: Watched the credits to the very end.
short_descr: The story isn't over until the last line.

name: Warm It Up
description: Warmed the egg until it glowed. Life begins.
short_descr: Eggs love heat.

name: Friendly Fire
description: Raided a friend you invited. Don't forget to say goodbye to your friendship.
short_descr: Keep your friends close...

name: Phoenix
description: Used all three revive rockets in one flight.
short_descr: Rise from the ashes. Again. And again.

name: Polyglot
description: Changed the language. The Sphinx approves.
short_descr: Riddles sound different in other languages.

name: Tree Shaker
description: Shook the tree hard enough.
short_descr: Some trees need a good shake.
